stops.note: Every flow starts here. A customer hits Booking Web from the public internet.
Booking Web is the consumer entry point. Double-click to drill into its internals — or follow the dashed edge to see how it hands off to Payments.
Notice the dashed edge labelled POST /authorise. That edge crosses the project boundary — its target lives in the Payments Platform, not in Booking. Watch what happens next.
We've crossed projects. Order API is the public REST surface of the Payments Platform; this is where every authorise / capture / refund enters.
Auth Engine is where the actual risk + processor routing happens. From here, requests fan out to the ledger, the event bus, and the PCI vault.
